items.question: Who is the main Indonesian record, and what identifies it?

items.question: How do the PFE rules treat a cell from a 1260H-linked maker, compared with anode material?
items.result_summary: IRS Notice 2026-15 quotes §7701(a)(51): a 'specified foreign entity' includes an entity identified under Section 1260H. Law-firm summaries: a 'foreign-influenced entity' includes one where a single specified foreign entity owns more than 25%. For §45X, the material-assistance cost ratio compares direct material costs not made by a PFE with all direct material costs; the required non-PFE share for battery components is 60% for components sold in 2026, rising to 85% by 2030 (critical minerals 0% in 2026, 25% in 2030). IRS safe-harbor tables are due by 31 Dec 2026.
items.interpretation: Cells and anode material sit at different points in the test. A US company buying finished cells counts the cell as one input, and what matters is who made the cell. Anode material is an input of the cell maker. We give no view on how the rules apply to any company here.
